name: Mandarin Orange Tonic | 100mg
description: Mandarin Orange Tonic is an incredibly delicious, cannabis infused beverage that incorporates a sophisticated liposomal encapsulation technology that delivers cannabinoids far more efficiently than traditional edibles.
